## 主张 Claim

对每条部分律与容许条件：性质在每段被允许的进程后、从它成立的每个起点都成立，恰当每个被允许的步保持它；计数的工作在 work + 1 次中完成恰当燃料够用，更短的运行不完成。可恢复设备是二者的实例。其历史（含中断）恰是被允许步的进程，所以持久的待完成描述与顺序覆写步在未完成时保持一致、发布时保持实际候选覆盖，跨每段有限的被允许中断历史成立，恰因每个被允许的步如此。待完成的恢复是计数的工作：n 次剩余写入与发布在 n + 1 次不中断步中完成，恰当储备够 n + 1 单位且期限够 n + 1 步；更短的恢复不发布。 / For every partial law and admission, a property holds after every admitted course from every start where it holds exactly when every admitted step keeps it; and counted work finishes in work + 1 ticks exactly when the fuel covers them, no shorter run finishing. The recoverable device is an instance of both. Its histories, interruptions included, are the courses of its admitted steps, so a durable pending description and sequential overwrite steps preserve coherence while incomplete and actual candidate coverage when published across every finite admitted interruption history, exactly because each admitted step does. A pending recovery is counted work: n remaining writes plus publication complete in n + 1 uninterrupted steps exactly when the reserve covers n + 1 units and the deadline n + 1 more steps, and no shorter resumption publishes.

Canonical source: [RecoverableControl.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/RecoverableControl.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 起始证据覆盖及当前读取规律；准备目标来自原权限／代次检查的 commit；待恢复描述、消耗账及门控持久且受保护。 / Initial evidence coverage and current read law; the prepared target comes from the preceding permission/generation-checked commit; pending description, consumption state and gate are durable and protected.
- 覆盖写入语义、单次写入／消耗原子性、准备及发布原子性、无额外写入或并行权限改变；中断保持已经发生的改变并带入明示延迟。 / Overwrite semantics, atomic individual write/consumption steps, atomic preparation/publication, no extra writer or concurrent grant change; interruptions retain completed effects and add a specified delay.
- 完成定理另需足够剩余资源、截止期及一个无中断后缀；一致性本身不保证这些条件。 / The completion theorem additionally requires sufficient remaining resources, deadline and an uninterrupted suffix; consistency alone does not ensure them.

实际改变、保留的恢复根据及行动访问是同一历史中的分化；Safe 仅表示证据相容，不表示活动无害或停止入口总是可用。 / Actual change, retained recovery grounds and access to action differentiate within one history; Safe denotes evidence coherence, not harmless activity or always-available shutdown.

## 检验与边界 Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1 新查22项定理／48项显式审计（17空、22仅propext、8另含Quot.sound、1再含Classical.choice）；九个继承证明模块及一个案例辅助模块另重编。27,888项同作者有限核对通过；完整签名、依赖及冻结哈希保留，无独立验收或硬件试验。一般律已由检查器回执绑定。 / Lean 4.29.1 checked 22 new theorems / 48 explicit audits (17 empty, 22 propext only, 8 also Quot.sound, 1 additionally Classical.choice); nine inherited proof modules and one case helper were separately rebuilt. 27,888 same-author finite comparisons passed; full signatures, dependencies and frozen hashes remain, without independent acceptance or hardware trials. General laws: checker receipts bound.

局部恢复及证据推论，不是硬件、编译器、持久屏障、任意不可逆效果、独立紧急停止或伦理充分性的验证。实际全部损害并未建模；不证明普遍趋同或零实质公理。 / Local recovery and evidential inference, not verification of hardware, compiler, persistence barriers, arbitrary irreversible effects, an independent emergency stop or ethical adequacy. Full intermediate harm is not modeled; universal convergence and zero substantive axioms are not proved.

- 九单位时第一次实际写入后恢复耗尽，活动仍在运行且普通停止被阻；删去持久标记又可暴露失实认证。 / With nine units, recovery exhausts after the first actual write while activity remains running and ordinary shutdown is blocked; losing the durable marker can instead expose a false certificate. [RecoverableControl.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/RecoverableControl.lean)
- 重复写入或中断延迟使22单位或23时限不足；此前消耗保留。 / Repeated writes or crash delay make 22 units or a 23-step deadline insufficient; prior consumption remains. [RecoverableControl.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/RecoverableControl.lean)
